description: Cost scenarios for is-this-backtest-lambo-or-lada, in Option Omega's own units. Copy this file, fill every field of every scenario with a number (0 is allowed but is named in the summary, and a slippage of 0 caps C7), and point the local config's costs.file at it. Only the scenario named as costs.base is read; the 2x-slippage run is computed from it. A missing, empty or non-numeric field stops the skill before any run request; nothing is ever filled with 0.

fields.entrySlippage: entry slippage per exit group (per side for a spread), in option points
fields.exitSlippage: slippage of a profit-target or time exit, in option points
fields.stopLossSlippage: slippage of a stop exit, in option points
fields.openingFees: fee per contract (per leg) to open, USD
fields.closingFees: fee per contract (per leg) to close, USD
